title: Variational autoencoder

paper.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Variational autoencoder: implement diagonal-Gaussian reparameterization and MNIST negative ELBO with explicit reconstruction and KL terms. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use mnist; required output: Image -> reconstruction logits posterior mean and log variance. Evaluate negative_elbo (minimize). State Bernoulli reconstruction likelihood and summed KL convention. Required ablation: Set the KL weight to zero and inspect posterior collapse and sample quality. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
